story-context.constraints: - Next.js 14 App Router pattern (NOT Pages Router) - All components must use 'use client' directive for interactive features - TypeScript strict mode enabled - File size limit: Components ≤ 500 lines (split if larger) - Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui components only (no custom CSS modules) - Apple Liquid Glass design system: backdrop-blur-md, bg-white/10, glassmorphism effects - Recharts library for all charts (already used in Stories 9-16) - React Query v5 patterns: staleTime, refetchInterval, retry config - RBAC: Admin-only access, redirect unauthorized users - Responsive design: Mobile (≤767px), Tablet (768-1023px), Desktop (≥1024px) - Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA, keyboard navigation, ARIA labels - Error handling: 404/403/500 HTTP errors with retry logic - Animation: 300ms transitions, respect prefers-reduced-motion - Testing: Jest + React Testing Library, 80%+ coverage target

tests.standards: Testing with Jest + React Testing Library following Next.js 14 patterns. Unit tests for components, hooks, and utilities. Integration tests for API interactions. Target 80%+ coverage. Mock React Query with createWrapper. Mock API responses with MSW (Mock Service Worker). Test user interactions with fireEvent and userEvent. Test accessibility with jest-axe. Snapshot tests for UI consistency.
